sources.entry: Awesome SRE Tools - A curated list of Site Reliability and Production Engineering tools

summary.one_liner: A curated Markdown list of Site Reliability Engineering and production engineering tools, organized by category from source control and CI/CD to monitoring, incident response, and AI SRE agents.
keywords: tools to get paged for outages
summary.what_it_does: The README is a single long list of tools grouped under headings such as Development, Continuous Testing, Continuous Integration, Continuous Delivery, Continuous Monitoring, Incident Management, Internal Developer Portal, and AI SRE Tools. Each entry is typically a name, sometimes with a one-line description, and many entries are commercial or hosted products. The list links to tools rather than documenting them, so the README itself contains no installation or usage details for the tools it names. It also includes a few related-list references to other awesome lists and learning roadmaps. The repository is maintained by Raghu Chinnannan and Squadcast, and the content is licensed under CC BY 4.0.
use_cases: Finding an SRE or DevOps tool for a specific category
Comparing incident management and on-call products
Choosing a monitoring or uptime tool
Discovering AI SRE and incident investigation agents
notable: Broad coverage from source control and CI through monitoring, incident response, and AI SRE agents
Includes an AI SRE Tools and SRE Copilots section
Some entries carry short descriptions of what each tool does
Maintained jointly by Raghu Chinnannan and Squadcast
caveats: Many entries are commercial or hosted products, and the list does not indicate pricing or open-source status for most of them
Entries are not vetted or ranked, and some are unrelated to SRE (for example, code editors and testing frameworks)
The list has no install or usage instructions because it is a link collection
